text:
elaine (People Ops): FYI several hiring teams reported post-interview recordings not appearing on candidate timelines. We had 6 interviews yesterday where the feedback form says "Recording attached" but there's no link.
devon (Recruiter): I hit this for candidate 4981 and 4984. Interviewers recorded with Zoom; recordings show up in our Zoom account but ATS timeline is empty.
zoombot: webhook:zoom-recordings-processor attempted delivery for meeting 843219 at 1755549000 -> HTTP 202 accepted but no S3 key returned.
nate (Interview Ops Eng): looking at the processor logs now. The handler calls Zoom -> downloads MP4 -> uploads to S3 then writes candidate asset record. I see successful upload responses but the DB write is failing with unique constraint on asset_id. That suggests duplicate retry created a conflicting row id.
sam (Hiring Manager): man this breaks async review. Interviewers expect the link in the GH issues feedback thread. Any ETA?
devon (Recruiter): we have a scheduled hiring panel in 8 hours; interviewers need to reference the recording before debrief. Can we surface a manual attach flow to the candidate timeline for ops?
nate (Interview Ops Eng): Yes - there's an admin UI (Admin > Candidate > Attach asset) that accepts a pre-signed URL. I'll make a small helper script to read latest uploads from the recordings S3 bucket and generate attach commands for the affected candidate IDs. That should be a 20-30m manual workaround.
elaine (People Ops): please escalate the list of affected candidate IDs to me once script runs. I'll message interviewers and recruiters so they don't lose context.
nate (Interview Ops Eng): root cause: when the ingestion worker gets a transient DB timeout it retries and the UUID generator produced colliding IDs for the asset row due to a bug in the fallback path. I can patch to use DB-side uuid() and add idempotency keys. Patch timeline: quick fix in ingestion worker for idempotency in 1-2 hours; full rollback plan if patch fails is to pause webhook processor and run backfill job.
devon (Recruiter): can we surface in the UI a label on the feedback form that says "Recording delivery delayed" so reviewers know not to expect links yet?
elaine (People Ops): yes please, add a soft banner. Also add a short note we can paste into candidate-facing comms if we need to manually attach later.
nate (Interview Ops Eng): adding instrumentation: count failed DB writes with error code 23505 and capture meeting_id + candidate_id (no PII). I will also reprocess the last 24h of webhooks after the fix.
zoombot: alert created: REC-2025-77 "zoom-recordings-asset-write-conflict" assigned to nate.
sam (Hiring Manager): thanks. Once manual attachments are done can you ping #people-ops and the panel channel? We'll triage feedback timing.
devon (Recruiter): script ran, attached recordings for 4981/4984/4989. Verified playback from candidate page. Attaching list to @elaine.
elaine (People Ops): got the list, emailing affected interviewers now with note and link to candidate pages. Template: "If you don't see the recording on the candidate timeline, refresh and check the \"Attachments\" section; contact People Ops if still missing."
nate (Interview Ops Eng): patch deployed to ingestion worker at 1755554621. Monitoring for 30m; will reprocess 24h backlog after green. Will follow up with counts.
devon (Recruiter): confirmed recordings reappear for new webhooks. thanks team! :raised_hands:
